transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, what brings me in today is that my eating has just gotten really off lately. Some days, I barely manage to get down a cup of coffee and maybe a granola bar before I head in for a shift. I've also noticed my scrubs have been hanging pretty loose on me, and I'm definitely not trying to lose any weight.
Are you avoiding food because you’re afraid of gaining weight or concerned about your body shape?
No, it's nothing like that. I don't care about my weight or how I look right now. I just... I really don't have any appetite at all. The thought of eating just doesn't appeal to me.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah, I have. Most mornings I just wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the day is already ruined before I even put on my badge to head in. I just feel really down.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I definitely have. I used to do a fair amount of stuff—run in Van Cortlandt Park, take photos, play chess with some friends. But now... I just tell myself there’s no point to any of it. Instead of going out, I mostly just end up sitting at home scrolling on my phone, or checking my budget spreadsheet. I just don't have the drive to do the things I used to enjoy.
How long have you been feeling this persistently down?

It's been a while. The steady feeling of being down, and just losing interest in everything... that settled in a bit later on. I'd say it has been with me for roughly the past year and four months now.
When you feel depressed, does that make eating feel unappealing?

Yeah, it really does. That's actually one of the main things that brought me in. My eating has just gotten completely off track. Some days, I barely manage to get down a cup of coffee and a granola bar before my shift. I'm just not hungry. And I've noticed my scrubs have been hanging loose on me lately, even though I'm definitely not trying to lose weight.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead or thoughts of harming yourself?

I haven't made any kind of plan to actually hurt myself, no. But... I do catch myself wishing I just wouldn't wake up in the morning. Or I think about how much easier it would be if I could just disappear. It's just a thought that crosses my mind when things feel too heavy.
